1: Sonia, Desalmada
Sonia has endured the infidelities of her husband, Fernando, for years, all out of fear that he will leave her. When he meets Marcela, his current lover, fear turns into hatred.
Mónica, Acorralada

Mónica suffers from constant abuse from her mother, Beatriz Fernández, who lives frustrated after her artistic career ended abruptly. Francisco, Mónica's boyfriend, gives her advice so she can get rid of her mother.
Margarita, Ponzoñosa
Teodora's uncle forces her to live with Jorge and his parents after finding out about the romance between the two. Jorge and Margarita belong to a religious cult where torture is the main motivator.
Jessica, Tóxica
Jessica is tired of her husband Rodolfo's abuse, with whom she has a small son. Rodolfo gets seriously ill.
Martha, Asfixiante

Martha, Pablo Sandoval's ex-wife, returns from Puebla and visits his house unexpectedly, taking her children without their father's permission. Pablo tells DIEM about the relationship he had with Martha and the details of their separation thanks to her mental disorders.
Claudia, Cuchillera

Claudia, a young drug addict, lives aimlessly, having no children, no husband, no mother to turn her away from an irremediable destiny. She decides to rob her ex-in-laws' house with her lover, but the owners of the house are still there.
Patricia, Vengadora

Patricia is a girl who suffers from domestic violence and sexual abuse by her father, who also abuses her mother and brother. One day things get out of control and Patricia decides to put an end to this situation.
Cándida, Esperanzada
Cándida is a prostitute who is about to retire. All she wants is a house and a man to protect her.
Emilia, Cocinera
Emilia is a middle-aged woman and victim of men. Her landlord sexually harasses her for owing him 3 months' rent. Her husband closes his eyes to her efforts to pay the debt.
Sandra, Trepadora

Sandra is an interested woman who lives in a small town and seeks to get out of there by seducing men at any price. Julián, the half-brother of her last husband Fermín, decides to investigate Sandra's past when he notices something strange.
Cristina, Rebelde
A prison police officer begins an affair with a lawyer to cover up her various illegal operations, but when he begins to suspect her, he ends up dead.
Ana, Corrosiva
Ana had an accident that led her to meet Sergio, a plastic surgeon, and fall in love with him. With that his misfortunes did not end, they just began.
Emma, Costurera

Ema, a great seamstress, is married to Mario, who became an invalid after suffering an assault in his sewing workshop. After a long time of abuse, Ema's patience reaches its limit when she discovers her partner's infidelity.
2: Clara, fantasiosa
A mentally disturbed woman attacks her husband's alleged lover after harassing her incessantly.
Las Garrido, codiciosas

The Garridos live in a small town as guests in the house of Concha Garrido's husband. Concha begins to rebel against her husband's abuse when she realizes that her nephew is beginning to follow in her footsteps.
Laura, confundida

In Laura's schizoid mind, realities are confused and she questions whether she is the culprit of her mother's murder, or if she is her own murdered mother, or if her boyfriend is the representation of her father, her mother's murderer.
Ana y Paula, ultrajadas

Ana and Paula have a beautiful relationship until Ana's work decisions begin to distance them. Juan Enrique, the director of the theater play where Paula works, takes advantage of the situation to force Paula to have sexual relations with him.
Rosa, heredera

Rosa, an ambitious hairdresser, will find in the elderly Inés a real possibility to escape her poverty, but in the perverse game of lies and manipulation that Inés establishes, no one knows who will turn out to be the victim.
Tita Garza, estafadora
Tita dedicates herself to swindling her friends by convincing them to invest their money with her in a large fund and then, when they ask for their capital back, she murders them.
Julia, encubridora

Julia the mother and Julia the daughter live in a sick labyrinth of half-truths, neuroses and imaginary worlds. But his world will be turned upside down by a new presence, as attractive as it is dangerous: that of Marco, the gym trainer.
Soledad, cautiva

Soledad, a 19-year-old girl, runs away from home due to constant problems with her father and stepmother. While wandering aimlessly along the road she meets Esteban, an attractive young man who entangles her to take her to a brothel.
Ofelia, enamorada
After more than forty years of marriage, Ofelia decides to take her husband's life to avoid a long and painful death.
Cecilia, prohibida
Cecilia becomes obsessed with her brother Luis and thinks they are soulmates.
Maria, pescadora

María, a fishmonger's employee, keeps her sick daughter while suffering abuse from her boss and is constantly humiliated by one of her colleagues at the market where she works. María's desperation reaches its limit when her fishmonger's shop is taken away.
Tere, desconfiada
The monotonous marriage of Tere and José will be disturbed by Gabriela, a seductive, manipulative and perverse teenager who is destined to completely change the lives of the bored Tere and José.
Carmen, honrada

Carmen is a humble lady who works as a maid in the house of a rich family. Everything gets complicated when Carmen takes her granddaughter Jennifer to visit, who falls in love with Leo, the only son of the lady of the house.
3: Irma, de los peces

Irma, a girl who loves fish, is married to Alfonso, a concert pianist much older than her. Her marriage full of violence and humiliation clouds Irma's judgment, leading her to think that there is no way out of her terrible situation.
Elena, Protectora

Elena moves to Pablo and his wife Claudine's house due to the convalescence she suffers thanks to a fall. The unhealthy love that Elena feels for her brother Pablo causes her to commit something crazy trying to defend him.
Azucena, Liberada

Hilario, Azucena's grandfather, sells her to Mr. Gregorio to be his wife in exchange for a small monthly payment to be able to survive in the town. Azucena, tired of the abuse her husband gives her, decides to put a stop to the situation.
Las Blanco, Viudas

Luz Blanco dedicated herself to murdering her 4 husbands in order to collect her insurance policies and avoid financial problems. Now, she teaches this lifestyle to her daughter Norma and her granddaughter Estela.
Eliana, Cunada

Eliana has had a lesbian romance with Joana at school, although she never accepts her homosexuality. Now older, and sublimating that love for her, she has married Franco, Joana's brother. Things get complicated when Joana, assumed without problems, reappears.
Elvira y Mercedes, Justicieras
Mercedes and Elvira move to Mexico City to improve their quality of life. When Mercedes realizes that her husband Domingo is sexually abusing her daughter Lupita, she decides to take revenge.
Annette y Ana, Nobles

Dr. Sofía Capellán and her team address the famous Van Diryk case that occurred in 1965, where Ana Gallardo is presumed to have killed the Count of Beltrán Peña, husband of her daughter Annete Van Diryk, to protect her from his mistreatment.
Thelma, Impaciente

Thelma, tired of the cynicism and boring life she has with her husband Enrique, looks for a change in her life. One day she hatches an ingenious plan to be able to murder her husband and collect the life insurance to give herself a great life.
Paula, Bailarina

A married man with a family falls in love with a transgender women at a strip club and willing to do anything for her, for he is blindly in love with "her" until everything starts to fall apart all in violence.
Marta, Manipuladora

Marta has a relationship with her stepfather from which she becomes pregnant. She finds out that he plans to abandon his family for business and decides to kill him, taking advantage of his mother's psychiatric condition.
María, Fanática

María is a religious fanatic who has the idea that the devil has taken over her daughter, unlike her youngest son, who thinks he is an angel. In the name of her religion, María commits an unforgivable act.
Luz, Arrolladora

Luz Mercedes lives tormented by the infidelities of her husband Amado. Luz María, Amado's ex-lover, becomes obsessed with the idea of ​​them getting back together. They both decide to take revenge against the person who hurt them.
Maggie, Pensionada

Based on the real case "La Mataviejitas". Maggie was seriously affected since her grandmother abused and sold her at 14 years old; As a result, she murders the elderly women who are pensioners at the institution where she works..
Las Cotuchas, Empresarias

Based on the real case "Las Poquianchis". Dr. Sofía Capellán tells DIEM about the renowned case of "Las Cotuchas", three sisters who owned a brothel where they instigated murders and mistreatment of their sexual servants, who were forced to work there.
